instruction.text: What material is this puzzle made of?
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Wood is a natural material. Trees can be replanted, so it is also a renewable resource. However, it takes many years for a tree to grow big and mature enough to be chopped down for wood.

If you look at a tree stump, you will see a ring for every year that the tree was alive and growing. This is because trees grow at different speeds in different seasons. As a result, every piece of wood has a unique pattern, which is called a grain.

atoms.a: What is the name of the striped pattern in wood that is caused by growth rings?

atoms.text: Dry wood burns very well, so it is also often used as fuel to make fires for warmth and cooking. Wood used for this purpose is called firewood.

atoms.a: How is wood used to generate heat?

atoms.text: Wood is a very versatile material. Since it is relatively easy to work with, it is used to make things like furniture, tools and even entire houses.

atoms.a: What is wood often used for?

atoms.text: The waste that is made when wood is processed can be used for other things. For example, wood shavings and sawdust can be pressed into chipboard, which in turn can be used to make furniture and houses. The fibres in scrap wood can also be used to make paper.

atoms.a: What can be made using scrap wood?
